pages.title: The path
pages.text: A nearby Sun-like star. After $(l:space/planets/proxima)Proxima B$(), the target is Tau Ceti F. It can only be seen with a telescope from Proxima B. Its corals are the only way to make an Eye of Ender. It takes a tier 6 rocket. It is the last stop on the way to the Parade of Planets.
